title: UCP checkout session status (v2026-08-25), with the AP2 lock

states.label: incomplete
states.note: Data missing or a recoverable error or Action outstanding. Messages say what to fix. expires_at defaults to 6 hours after creation.

states.label: requires_escalation
states.note: Needs buyer input or buyer review. continue_url is required, with a requires_buyer_input or requires_buyer_review message.

states.label: ready_for_complete
states.note: All data present and no Action outstanding. The platform may call Complete Checkout. With AP2 negotiated, every response here carries ap2.merchant_authorization.

states.label: complete_in_progress
states.note: Complete accepted for asynchronous processing; no order yet. An Action (for example a 3DS challenge) can be outstanding. No new Update or Complete; on trouble the platform follows fallback, handoff, then cancel.

states.label: completed
states.note: Order placed; order.id and order.permalink_url present. Immutable. The business sends a confirmation email.

states.label: canceled
states.note: Canceled by the platform or invalid or expired. Start a new session if needed.

transitions.trigger: All information collected, no Action outstanding
Business needs data its API cannot collect, or a policy needs buyer review
Buyer finishes on the business UI through continue_url
Complete Checkout accepted for asynchronous processing
Complete returns a recoverable change (for example payment_failed or out_of_stock)
Complete returns a buyer handoff (requires_buyer_input or requires_buyer_review)
Business finishes processing; any Action resolved
Platform cancels, or the session expires
Platform cancels, or the session expires
Platform cancels, or the session expires
Session invalid or expired (cancellation race rules apply)
